passage.title: A NEW PLACE TO LIVE
passage.subtitle: A different way of life
paragraphs: Moving to a new city can be difficult, especially when you do not know many people. However, it can also be an exciting experience. You can discover new places, try different food and make new friends.

Last year, Emma moved from a small village to Manchester because she found a new job there. At first, she didn't like living in a big city. The streets were busy, and there were too many cars. She also missed her old friends and her family's house.

After a few weeks, Emma started to enjoy her new life. She joined a sports club near her apartment and met some friendly people. She also found a small supermarket and a good Italian restaurant close to her home. At weekends, she often visits the city centre with her new friends. They sometimes go shopping or watch films at the cinema.

Emma says that she still loves her village, but she doesn't want to move back at the moment. She thinks that living in Manchester gives her more opportunities to learn new things and meet different people.
